findings.title: Three active Half products are publicly orderable at zero price
findings.evidence: CQM-HF-SW-SVR, CQMD-HF-SW-SVR, and PPZ-HF-SW-SVR have retail_price=0 and appear in the public catalog. A zero-price item can be added and the enabled submit action shows a PHP 0.00 total. The backend catalog and submission queries explicitly allow retail_price >= 0.
findings.recommended_action: Immediately disable or correctly price the three SKUs, then require retail_price > 0 in both public catalog and submission validation with regression tests.

findings.title: The generic offline queue can persist credentials and replay unsafe writes
findings.evidence: On a fetch failure, every non-GET mutation outside a small denylist is written to hh_offline_db. POST /login is not excluded, so its username and password body can be stored in IndexedDB. Stock, consignment, warehouse-transfer, batch-intake, user-management, and administrative mutations can also be replayed after an uncertain delivery.
findings.recommended_action: Replace the denylist with an explicit allowlist of idempotent offline operations, permanently exclude authentication and privileged mutations, remove or quarantine legacy unsafe rows, and add automated offline/reconnect tests.

findings.title: Current local code expects database structures missing in production
findings.evidence: Production is missing ingredient_price_history plus six cost-snapshot columns on each of consignment_items, market_event_sale_items, and reseller_order_items, for 18 missing columns total.
findings.recommended_action: Treat the reviewed migrations as a deployment prerequisite and run a schema preflight before deploying the current local implementation.

findings.title: Sheet edits are not updating the Hub
findings.evidence: All six Sheet-sync tables are empty and the five required Google Sheets server environment variables are absent. Live comparison found three unique SRP differences and three Full/Half SKU collisions. Jar cost has no safe canonical mapping.
findings.recommended_action: Correct duplicate SKUs, apply the migrations, configure the read-only service account environment, run a manual dry run with auto-apply off, then enable bounded price auto-apply only after one verified test.

findings.title: Current product-cost outputs are not fully trustworthy
findings.evidence: Five zero-priced ingredients affect 31 products through 51 recipe links; eight active products have no recipe; eleven recipes have nonpositive yield; and ST-SAM-SWT computes to PHP 548.08 total cost against PHP 245 SRP.
findings.recommended_action: Repair source prices, recipe references, yields, and missing recipes before using margin and weekly food-cost outputs for decisions.

findings.title: Supplier-linked price alerts cannot be authoritative
findings.evidence: The live database has zero suppliers and all 134 ingredients lack supplier links. The live production schema also lacks ingredient_price_history.
findings.recommended_action: Create the supplier master, link ingredients, establish stable packaging and ingredient identifiers, and capture normalized unit-price history before enabling supplier or price-hike alerts.

findings.title: Checkout is buried and a category control overflows on phone widths
findings.evidence: At 390x844 the order form begins about 10,497 CSS pixels down, roughly 12.4 screens after 46 product cards. At 412x915 it begins about 11.2 screens down. The Sandwiches & Salads category control extends beyond the measured phone width.
findings.recommended_action: Use filter-first browsing with a sticky cart or bottom-sheet checkout, keep category controls within the viewport, and enforce 44-pixel mobile targets.

findings.title: Two sandwich products are classified as spreads
findings.evidence: PCLB-HF-SW-SVR and WMS-HF-SW-SWT match Sweet/Savory checks before the -SW- sandwich rule in both frontend and owner-dashboard category logic.
findings.recommended_action: Give explicit sandwich SKU/name rules precedence, centralize the mapping contract, and add shared frontend/backend fixtures.

findings.title: Current POS safety is strong, but legacy sale traceability is incomplete
findings.evidence: Current client-reference idempotency and stock reconciliation pass. Historical data still has 12 sales without client_reference, 10 cash sales without cash_received, and two sales without idempotency markers.
findings.recommended_action: Preserve current safeguards, mark legacy rows explicitly, and avoid inferring tender or change for historical records.

findings.title: Stock mirrors reconcile, but batch and ledger history need cleanup
findings.evidence: Main Facility ingredient and SKU mirrors have zero drift and no negative stock. Four ingredient batch balances differ from available stock, and 21 zero-quantity manual-adjustment rows were created during event closeouts.
findings.recommended_action: Reconcile the four legacy batch balances and stop writing zero-quantity business ledger entries.

findings.title: Core backend tests pass, but browser-offline and live workflow proof is incomplete
findings.evidence: All 138 backend tests pass, including market-event idempotency, stock rollback, pre-order, and production completion. There is no frontend test command or automated IndexedDB/offline suite, no completed live production plan, and no current live consignment delivery data.
findings.recommended_action: Add deterministic frontend offline tests and stage one complete production, consignment, pre-order, and reconnect lifecycle before release.

findings.title: Eleven RLS-enabled tables have no explicit policy
findings.evidence: Supabase reports informational rls_enabled_no_policy findings for newer tables. RLS is enabled on all public tables, so anon/authenticated access is denied rather than exposed.
findings.recommended_action: Document the intended API-only model and add narrowly scoped service-role policies only if PostgREST access is required.
